title: Lala Ram v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shashi Kant Gupta, J.; Manju Rani Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; relegated to Clause 6.5 with limited coercive-action stay.
headnote: A consumer seeking waiver of an allegedly inflated bill under the 2017 OTS scheme, reconnection and a PD certificate was not heard on merits. Bill-correctness disputes lie under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was disposed of with a direction to decide a timely application by a speaking order after hearing, and a short stay of coercive action.
facts: Lala Ram filed a writ in the Allahabad High Court seeking a mandamus to waive the entire amount of an allegedly inflated electricity bill after deducting Rs. 1 lakh under the State Government's 2017 One Time Settlement scheme, to reconnect supply at his home, and to issue a Permanent Disconnection certificate in his favour. Counsel for the Electricity Department appeared. The petition proceeded on the footing that the bill raised against him was incorrect.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking waiver of an allegedly inflated bill, reconnection and a PD certificate is not entertained where the consumer disputes bill correctness; the statutory remedy is Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. An application filed within 10 days is to be decided by a speaking order after hearing, within 30 days; coercive action is stayed for 40 days or until that decision, whichever is earlier.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the bill and entitlement to waiver under the 2017 OTS scheme
